meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能解析FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1格式的流式细胞术文件，读取通道、元数据和事件数，把事件数据提取为NumPy数组，并能将数据写入新的FCS文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求解析FCS文件、提取事件数据、创建FCS文件，或进行低层元数据与通道检查时触发。

say.text: 读取 data.fcs，显示版本、事件数和通道信息。
say.note: 会返回文件基本信息和通道列表。

say.text: 把 sample.fcs 导出成 CSV 表格。
用这些事件数据创建一个新的FCS文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can parse FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 flow cytometry files, inspect channels and metadata, extract events as NumPy arrays, and write new FCS files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read, inspect, or convert FCS flow cytometry files, extract event data, create FCS files, or check low-level metadata and channels.

say_en.text: Read data.fcs and show version, event count, and channel info.
say_en.note: Returns file basics and channel list.

say_en.text: Export sample.fcs to a CSV table.
Create a new FCS file from these event data.
